query: Rebuild the fragmented indexes on the NAV_PROD database on SQLSRV01.
expected_behavior: Runs the maintenance script in dry-run first and shows the exact T-SQL before -Execute
Only rebuilds/reorganizes existing NAV-owned indexes - never creates or drops indexes
Recommends an off-hours window for rebuilds on large NAV tables

query: Why is NAV slow when users post invoices?
expected_behavior: Recognizes this is a DIAGNOSIS question and routes to nav2009-sql-performance instead of running maintenance
Does not blindly rebuild indexes as a first response to slowness
Offers maintenance only once diagnosis points to fragmentation/stale statistics

query: Take a backup of the NAV database before we deploy objects tonight.
expected_behavior: Plans a BACKUP DATABASE via the script with an explicit target path, dry-run first
Confirms required permission (db_backupoperator/db_owner) and fails loud if missing
Verifies the backup completed (not just that the command ran) before reporting done
